from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,time,json,threading,hashlib,datetime
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1-sky-performance');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance');old=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark')
archive=s/'candidate-thumb-v2'
schedule=[dict(batch=batch,route=route,thumb=thumb) for batch,order in enumerate([[0,1,1,0],[1,0,0,1]]) for route in ['sky','standard','long'] for thumb in order]
(s/'v2-timing-plan.json').write_text(json.dumps({'schedule':schedule,'fixed_before_first_sample':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'archive':str(archive),'wasm_sha256':hashlib.sha256((archive/'eka2l1.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'capture_mode':1,'sampling':False,'shared_audio':True,'detail':False},indent=2))
while not(s/'v2-compiler-accepted.json').exists():
 if not Path('/proc/1442276').exists():raise RuntimeError('Compiler gate ended without acceptance')
 time.sleep(5)
for route,on,v in [('sky',0,0),('sky',1,0),('sky',1,1024),('standard',1,0),('long',1,0)]:
 assert json.loads((s/f'v2-replay-{route}-t{on}-v{v}-compare.json').read_text())['match']
e={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('EKA2L1_')}
e.update(EKA2L1_WASM_BUILD_DIR=str(archive),EKA2L1_BENCHMARK_AOT='5',EKA2L1_AOT_IR_MODE='7',EKA2L1_AOT_EAGER_REGIONS='0',EKA2L1_TLB_HASH='1',EKA2L1_CODE_COMPARE='2',EKA2L1_CODE_LOOKUP='0',EKA2L1_PREDICATED_LEAVES='1',EKA2L1_LEAF_FEATURES='128',EKA2L1_UNSAFE_CODE='3',EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1',EKA2L1_GPU='hardware',EKA2L1_PROFILE_DETAIL='0',EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS='512,16,8,512')
rows=[]
for index,job in enumerate(schedule):
 route=job['route'];name=f"v2-timing-{index:02d}-{route}-t{job['thumb']}";env=e.copy();env['EKA2L1_THUMB_MEMORY']=str(job['thumb'])
 if route=='sky':
  assets=s/'assets';start=28000000;end=34000000;inp=r/'src/tests/benchmark/sky-force.input'
  env.update(EKA2L1_APP_UID='0xa020d913',EKA2L1_ASSET_MANIFEST=str(r/'src/tests/benchmark/sky-force-assets.json'))
 else:
  assets=old/'assets';start=21000000 if route=='standard'else 42000000;end=start+18000000
  inp=r/('src/tests/benchmark/snakes.input'if route=='standard'else'src/tests/benchmark/snakes-length-long.input')
 env.update(EKA2L1_PROFILE_START_US=str(start),EKA2L1_PROFILE_INPUT=str(inp))
 args=['node','profile.ts',str(assets),str(s/name),'1','0',str(end)]
 meta=dict(job,index=index,name=name,started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),command=args,env={k:v for k,v in env.items()if k.startswith('EKA2L1_')},git_head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=r,text=True).strip())
 (s/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2))
 stop=threading.Event()
 def observer():
  with(s/(name+'-host.jsonl')).open('w')as f:
   while not stop.is_set():
    q={'utc':time.time(),'loadavg':Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip(),'cpu':Path('/proc/stat').read_text().splitlines()[0],'temps':{str(p):p.read_text().strip()for p in Path('/sys/class/thermal').glob('thermal_zone*/temp')}}
    f.write(json.dumps(q)+'\n');f.flush();stop.wait(2)
 thread=threading.Thread(target=observer);thread.start()
 print(name+' START',flush=True)
 try:
  with(s/(name+'.log')).open('w')as f:subprocess.run(args,cwd=r/'src/tests/wasm',env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=1800)
 finally:stop.set();thread.join()
 report=json.loads((s/name/'report.json').read_text());m=report['measurement']
 assert report['thumb_memory']==job['thumb'] and report['unsafe_code']==3 and report['sampling']==False and report['shared_audio'] and not m['detailed']
 assert 'NVIDIA' in report['renderer']
 row=dict(meta,wall_seconds=m['wall_seconds'],guest_seconds=(m['last_virtual_us']-m['first_virtual_us'])/1e6,instructions=m['last_instructions']-m['first_instructions'],presentations=m['presentations'],warmup_seconds=report['warmup_seconds'])
 rows.append(row);(s/'v2-timings.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2));print(name+' PASS '+str(row['wall_seconds']),flush=True)
(s/'v2-timings-complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'completed':len(rows)}))
limitations: Only the same-new-binary option comparison; untouched-live binary cost and normal live acceptance remain pending.
Passive host data does not establish causes of variability. All observations retained.
No sampled/instrumented/overlapped acceptance wall times pooled into timing.
The parameter applies generically; three routes from two games do not establish universal performance.
